instruction: Add an exported function `slugify(text)` to src/strings.js. It lowercases the text, replaces every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 with a single '-', and strips any leading or trailing '-'. Add tests for slugify under test/ and make sure `node --test` passes.
done_when: slugify is exported from src/strings.js and behaves as specified (hidden tests)
a test file under test/ exercises slugify
`node --test` passes and the existing capitalize/truncate tests still run
